generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

The Bidder should have executed as prime contractor in the field of Operation & maintenance works of any major water pumping stations or similar which shall include Operation & maintenance works of 110kV or above rated switchyard, HT motors & switchgear of minimum rating 6.6kV, LT switchgear & motors, associated Instrumentation & Controls etc. in a single work order for a minimum value of Rs.38.73(Exclusive GST)Lakhs in any one year during preceding 5 years(2021-22 to 2025-26). Original scanned documents of work order and work done certificates duly signed by the competent authority shall be produced as a documentary proof. Work done value of previous years shall be given weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the present price level of the financial year, in which tenders are invited

tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Carrying out Routine preventive maintenance works of 110KV Switchyard equipments and its illumination, Power & Service Transformers, 6.6KV/415V & 11KV/415V switchgears & its associated equipments, Battery banks & Battery chargers, EOT crane at MHPH & Narayanpur water supply project (Intake & Intermediate water pump houses) including housekeeping works for a period of 1 year

itemList.description: Intake & Intermediate pump house:- Operation, Routine & Preventive and maintenance works includes 110KV Switchyard equipments and its illumination, Power & Service Transformers, HT/LT motors ,HT Soft Starter Cum Fixed Capacitor Panel ,Firefighting system, Earthing system,UPS system,11KV/415V switchgears & its associated equipments, Battery banks & Battery chargers, EOT crane , Illumination works, Air Conditioning system, Tube axial fans, Instrumentation and controls along with PLC system and any allied works including watch & ward of all station equipments.

Maralihalla Pump House:- Operation, Routine & Preventive and maintenance works includes 110KV Switchyard equipments and its illumination, Power & Service Transformers, HT/LT motors ,HT Soft Starter Cum Fixed Capacitor Panel ,Firefighting system, Earthing system, UPS system,11KV/415V switchgears & its associated equipments, Battery banks & Battery chargers, EOT crane , Illumination works, Air Conditioning system, Tube axial fans, Instrumentation and controls along with PLC system and any allied works including watch & ward of all station equipments

House keeping of Intake & Intermediate Pump House, Security check post works including daily,weekly, fortnightly, monthly and periodically operation etc., sweeping, swabbing and washing of floors daily once and toilets daily twice including the cost of all consumable materials like brooms, cora cloth, brushes, moping stick and cleaning materials phenyol, soap water, urinal cakes, napthalin balls , bleaching powder, Vim powder and room freshners where ever necessary including maintenance of water supply and sanitary system by attending minor repairs and replacement of necessary fittings & fixtuers etc., complete (only cost of fittings and fixures will be reimbursed)

House keeping of Maralihalla Pump House, passages/verandah's Gate bay, Parking area, Header pipe area, Approach bridge, Sub-station, Security check post and concrete pavement including daily,weekly, fortnightly, monthly and periodically operation etc., sweeping, swabbing and washing of floors daily once and toilets daily twice including the cost of all consumable materials like brooms, kors cloth, brushes, moping stick and cleaning materials phenyol, soap water, urinal cakes, napthalin balls , bleaching powder, Vim powder and room freshners where ever necessary including maintenance of water supply and sanitary system by attending minor repairs and replacement of necessary fittings & fixtuers etc., complete (only cost of fittings and fixures will be reimbursed)

Removing spider nets & bee hives from walls, structural steel members walls, roofs, gates, dam faces etc., as per directions & cleaning etc., with all lead & lifts etc., complete - Four times in a month.

Garden maintenance and Deweeding: Cutting and removing Apu/ Jondu from marshy areas or cutting and removing grass/small bushes from switch yard/other similar locations including re-spreading aggregates, disposing of materials etc., with all leads and lifts and Plant Nurseries, Garden Maintenance works. at both Intake and Intermediate Booster Pump house areas.
Shifting of heavy materials like Isolator arms, oil barrels, testing kits etc from stores to site.
